concerns.text: Tasks T002, T003, and T004 are marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but they implicitly depend on the directory structure created by T001. Running them before T001 would cause file‑system errors. Add an explicit dependency on T001 or remove the `[P]` tag.

Task ID **T031** is duplicated: in `tasks.md` it implements the Sparse Autoencoder, while in `plan.md` it is described as “Finalize model integration”. Duplicate IDs create ambiguity in the execution order and break deterministic scheduling. Resolve the conflict by assigning distinct IDs and updating downstream dependencies.
